retrievalProfile.description: A weathered, multi-layered band portrait featuring a central group in front of a yellow vehicle framed by distressed damask borders and heavy grit textures.
triggerTerms: grungy band portrait with yellow bus

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person band portrait set against a yellow school bus, characterized by a heavy 'grunge' overlay, distressed damask-patterned borders at the top and bottom, and high-contrast, warm-toned lighting that emphasizes texture and grit.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group framed by the open door and windows of a yellow bus
Distressed damask borders sandwiching the central photographic area
Aggressive textural overlays creating a weathered, vintage paper feel
High-contrast lighting on subjects against a darker, cluttered interior
coreInvariants: Yellow bus as the primary environmental anchor
Heavy grit and scratch textures across the entire composition
Warm, desaturated color palette with high local contrast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three male subjects in the mid-ground, staggered in depth, occupying the central 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow school bus exterior provides the primary color and structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large top-aligned logo, moves down to the central figures, and settles on the bottom-right aligned title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects, vehicle details, and textural overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted yellow and ochre from the bus and weathered paper textures.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows in the bus interior and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Faded reds and greens within the damask border patterns.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with low overall saturation, leaning into a sepia-adjacent warmth.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with aggressive slants and irregular baselines.
letterConstructionRules: Varying heights within a single word
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'L' and 'T' have elongated, sharp horizontal bars that overlap adjacent characters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, interlocking custom logo paired with a cleaner, stamped stencil-style secondary text.
graphicDevices: Horizontal dark bands separating the borders from the main image

preserve: Interlocking nature of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 'stamped' look of the bottom text.
Required for the aggressive, interlocking top logo style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, high-contrast photo of three men standing in front of an old yellow school bus. Apply a heavy grunge texture, light leaks, and a weathered damask pattern border at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, interlocking, distressed white logo at the top center with a slight upward tilt. Add a three-line, right-aligned, white stamped-stencil title in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the texture heavy and consistent across the image?
Does the top text interlock and appear eroded?
Is the yellow bus the primary color anchor?
Are the damask borders present at top and bottom?

adjustableVariables: Degree of interlocking in the top typography
mustRedesign: Specific bus decals or identification numbers

mustAchieve: Strong visual hierarchy between logo and title
Cohesive integration of subjects and environment
avoid: Floating text that doesn't feel 'part' of the texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite heavy distressing.
Check that the damask pattern doesn't overpower the subjects.
Verify the yellow of the bus is muted and not neon.
Confirm the interlocking typography feels intentional and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a central subject group + frame with a textured vehicle + add distressed damask borders + apply heavy grit overlay + use interlocking eroded display type.
